clips.start_words: You need to have pitch blackness
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the room you sleep in matters as much as what you eat.

His own setup: pitch-black darkness, no stray lights left on from a smoke detector or a charger, and a black silk mask over the eyes when the room can't go fully dark.

His reasoning: real darkness lets the body make more melatonin, and a silk mask does the same job when blackout isn't possible.

What's the one light in your bedroom you've never covered?

#kevintrudeau #sleephygiene #wbdaily #healthtruth #naturalsleep #readthelabel

Kevin Trudeau says a magnesium deficiency from ultra-processed food is one of the most common nutrient gaps around - and one of his own fixes is as simple as bath time.

His routine: a couple of cups of magnesium-rich bath salts in warm water before bed. He says the skin absorbs the magnesium right along with the muscles relaxing.

He's quick to add he doesn't sell it and earns nothing if you buy it - he just says it's part of his own night routine.

Comment HEALTH and we'll send you what a real magnesium routine looks like.

Kevin Trudeau says most people shopping for fish oil never ask the real questions.

His checklist: is the fish wild or farm-raised, and if it's wild, was it pulled from clean water or a sewage-heavy area? What chemical did the company use to get the oil out, and what do they use to keep it from going rancid on the shelf?

His take: skip those questions and you may be paying for oil that's already turned before you ever open the bottle.

Which of those have you actually checked on your own bottle?

#kevintrudeau #omega3 #wbdaily #readthelabel #healthtruth #fishoil

Kevin Trudeau says there's a simple nose-breathing pattern he's taught for years at his own seminars and partner calls.

His method: breathe in through the nose with your attention about two inches below your belly button, let the stomach rise, then exhale through the nose and let it fall. Just 10 breaths, a few times a day.

He pairs it with Transcendental Meditation, which he says has been studied in roughly a hundred trials worldwide.
